dimensions.label: Successful external repository runs
dimensions.description: Public or explicitly authorized repository runs that complete within a declared boundary and retain aggregate evidence only.
dimensions.collectionRule: Count each repository and revision once; retain both successful runs and bounded failures so the denominator cannot be inflated.

dimensions.label: Repeat non-maintainer contributors
dimensions.description: Contributors outside the maintainer group who make at least two accepted public contributions in the declared window.
dimensions.collectionRule: Count only consented public contribution records; do not infer identity from private telemetry, downloads, or account activity.

dimensions.label: Release stability
dimensions.description: Reproducible release and rollback outcomes for public tagged artifacts.
dimensions.collectionRule: Count only published or explicitly rehearsed release artifacts with checksums, install smoke tests, and rollback evidence.

dimensions.label: Issue quality
dimensions.description: Public reports that contain a reproducible boundary, useful evidence, and an explicit disposition.
dimensions.collectionRule: Sample public issues with a declared rubric; do not use issue volume, stars, or views as quality proxies.

dimensions.label: Maintainer load
dimensions.description: Consent-based effort and support burden needed to review, release, secure, and maintain the project.
dimensions.collectionRule: Record manually supplied aggregate ranges and assumptions; never infer hours from presence, timestamps, or background activity.

dimensions.label: Security history
dimensions.description: Publicly disclosed security findings, response state, and recurring boundary failures.
dimensions.collectionRule: Use public advisories and reviewed security records; do not scan private repositories or turn absence of a report into a zero-risk claim.

dimensions.label: Retention or feedback
dimensions.description: Consented follow-up evidence that a non-maintainer found the workflow useful and returned or provided structured feedback.
dimensions.collectionRule: Retain only anonymized public or explicitly authorized summaries with consent, evidence, privacy review, and a backlog decision.

dimensions.label: Adopter feedback coverage
dimensions.description: External adopter evaluations that distinguish confirmed value, unsupported behavior, and unresolved limitations.
dimensions.collectionRule: Count only the public, consented, anonymized records defined by the community feedback contract; a missing record is not a zero-value claim.

limitations: This five-repository compatibility sample is not representative of the TypeScript ecosystem.
The three successful runs and two bounded failures are compatibility observations, not population-wide precision, recall, or adoption claims.
The snapshot has no consented external contributor records; absence of a record is not evidence of zero contributors.
CARTOGRAPH has no public package release in this snapshot; local release rehearsal is not a public release-stability series.
The public triage rubric exists, but no sampled issue-quality series has been collected or retained.
No maintainer time or support-load telemetry is collected; a capacity range requires an explicitly supplied future review.
The public policy and threat model define the response boundary, but this snapshot does not claim a complete security-history census or zero incidents.
There are zero external feedback records in the consented snapshot, so retention is not measured and no retention claim is permitted.
The current feedback contract contains one synthetic maintainer baseline and zero external adopter records; it makes no adoption or traction claim.

strategyGate.reason: Three successful public compatibility runs demonstrate a bounded technical sample, but no representative external retention, contributor, release, maintainer-load, security-history, or adopter-feedback evidence exists.
